review.scope: Subject-matter and curriculum navigation plus bounded summaries of the existing claim records. This is not a fresh scientific evidence review, formal certainty grade or validated curriculum taxonomy.
review.reviewer: AI-assisted editorial taxonomy review; independent human scientific review pending

domains.title: Perception & interpretation
domains.question: What was observed—and what was inferred?
domains.summary: Appraisals, imagery and alternative readings, with facts and interpretations kept distinct.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Its existing practice separates observation, bodily sensation, interpretation and urge.
Its existing goal is revising a claim in response to relevant counterevidence.
Its existing practice compares models and discriminating observations.

modelLinks.rationale: The account distinguishes perceived demand and capability; it is not a physiology calculator.
This competing theoretical account concerns concepts, context and experience; linkage is not endorsement or consensus.

domains.title: Emotion & regulation
domains.question: Which response fits this context—and where are the limits?
domains.summary: Emotional responses and strategy fit, alongside clinical and biological boundary records that must not become personal treatment advice.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Notice experience without treating it as proof of an interpretation.
The existing practice distinguishes chosen conduct from requiring emotional absence.
The existing goal is sustaining capacity and correcting plans when conditions change.

modelLinks.rationale: Demand and resource appraisals provide one explanatory account, not a universal response rule.
Constructed experience is a theoretical account with alternatives, not an established universal mechanism.
Context-sensitive response expression is a related learning account, not evidence for this product.

domains.title: Learning & memory
domains.question: What changed, under which conditions, and did it transfer?
domains.summary: Memory updating, experimental boundary conditions and the distinction between neural change and useful learning.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Compare mechanisms and predictions instead of inferring them from a feeling.
Its existing practice requires observed performance in a new context; neural or imagined change alone is insufficient.
Retention, recovery and later correction are the existing curricular focus.

modelLinks.rationale: The account concerns competing learning and the return of responses across contexts.
The account concerns retrieval-linked modification under constrained experimental conditions.

domains.title: Identity & habits
domains.question: What is a self-description—and what is demonstrated?
domains.summary: Self-reports of capability, context-linked automaticity and the proposed identity-to-competence integration. The habit findings come from specific observational studies; the integration's added benefit remains unestablished.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Its existing goal concerns combining capacities without hiding tensions.
Observed performance, not a changed self-description, is the existing educational criterion.
Its existing practice asks about observable conduct, without demanding a transformed identity or absent feeling.

modelLinks.rationale: Self-efficacy concerns perceived capability; it is related context rather than a theory proving identity change or habit formation.

domains.title: Relationships & belonging
domains.question: What supports connection without surrendering boundaries?
domains.summary: Distinctions among loneliness, social isolation and solitude, plus bounded studies of affect and specified loneliness interventions. These findings do not establish a universal cause or validate a custom cure.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Its existing practice considers consent, expertise and where another person's authority begins.
Its existing practice combines firmness and care in an ordinary conversation.
Its observation practice can separate what another person did from an inference about intention.

domains.title: Agency & self-command
domains.question: What can I choose, what requires support, and what is not mine to control?
domains.summary: Perceived capability, feasible conduct and context-sensitive revision—not guaranteed control over feelings, other people or outcomes.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Its existing practice distinguishes control, influence, consent and others' decisions.
Its existing goal is deliberate conduct while ordinary activation may remain.
Its existing criterion is observed performance with acknowledged failure and limits.
Its existing practice revises plans when capacity or conditions drift.

modelLinks.rationale: Perceived resources can inform approach, but do not establish objective capacity or safety.
Transfer and context provide a rival explanatory lens; they do not prove a willpower mechanism.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The saved claim supports distinguishing demand and resource appraisals, not a universal numeric anxiety formula or validated site exercise.

domainLinks.rationale: The claim is explicitly about two appraisals of a situation.
The saved context is adult laboratory stress, not a general treatment result.
Perceived resources relate to possible action but are not objective skill, support or safety.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Distinguish what is appraised from what is observed.
Examine the scope of the appraisal model.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The bounded account includes experimental findings, methodological clarifications and protocol-specific nonreplications. The later same-laboratory study also has control-retention limits; these results neither establish reliable self-guided memory erasure nor refute all reconsolidation research.

domainLinks.rationale: The proposition concerns retrieval-linked memory updating and its boundary conditions.
Human conditioned-fear and drug-assisted experiments constrain interpretation of emotional change; they are not personal emotion-regulation instructions.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Separate proposed mechanism from an observed result.
Compare the original human result with its registered replication and the stated scope.
Later corrections, retention outcomes and replication findings can require revising an earlier explanation.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The saved record supports imagery-evoked emotion in studied conditions; it does not establish self-guided clinical efficacy, memory rewriting or real-world competence.

domainLinks.rationale: The record distinguishes imagination from perception and reality judgments.
Its scoped proposition is that imagery can evoke emotional responses.
The claim explicitly limits any inference from imagined experience to memory change or demonstrated learning.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Notice emotional experience without treating it as proof of literal events.
Keep imagined practice separate from demonstrated performance.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The record concerns the existence of intervention-specific clinical evidence, not guaranteed recovery or transfer of efficacy to this self-guided site.

domainLinks.rationale: Condition-specific clinical interventions provide a boundary against blanket claims and self-guided treatment extrapolation.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Judge a named intervention within its actual condition, comparator and outcome.
The site does not select an individual's treatment; clinical expertise and consent remain distinct.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The record distinguishes perceived capability from observed performance while acknowledging their association, access-depth limits and unresolved causal direction.

domainLinks.rationale: Felt capability is a self-description, not evidence that identity or habits have changed.
The proposition directly distinguishes feeling capable from demonstrating a skill.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Use observed skill rather than self-confidence as the relevant performance record.
Keep association and causal explanation separate.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: Theory and contextual associations support a repertoire heuristic, not a universally best strategy or validated custom instrument.

domainLinks.rationale: Context-sensitive selection and revision apply to possible readings without declaring any lens universally best.
The cited conceptual account and reappraisal association concern strategy fit and feedback.
The saved proposition concerns selecting a feasible response and revising it with feedback.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Revise an interpretation when relevant feedback warrants it.
Consider compatible strategies without treating one as always correct.
Choose a context-sensitive response rather than demand a particular feeling.
Use later feedback to maintain or change a response.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The existing record says the integrated sequence's incremental benefit is an open research question, not a validated standalone intervention or competence certificate.

domainLinks.rationale: This is the canonical record for the original Identity-to-Competence integration; it does not establish a general habit-change effect.
The proposed integration concerns intended and demonstrated conduct, but added benefit remains unestablished.

disciplineLinks.rationale: The sequence is an integration proposal to inspect, not an established result.
Completing the proposed loop does not certify capability.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The saved account is limited to mouse receptor manipulations and distinct measured endpoints; no beneficial human learning or clinical efficacy follows.

domainLinks.rationale: This boundary record explains why neural remodeling does not by itself establish useful learning.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Distinguish a biological endpoint from a functional learning explanation.
Preserve species, endpoint and access-depth limits.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The record concerns controlled mouse behavioral and inflammatory endpoints, not human diagnosis, belief transfer or a general treatment effect.

domainLinks.rationale: Animal biological context is relevant to limits on purely interpretive explanations; it is not personal regulation advice.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Consider biological context while preserving species and measurement distinctions.
Do not turn mouse behavioral labels into a human diagnosis or percentage benefit.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The saved record distinguishes symptom-score and remission endpoints and records heterogeneous reviews with unresolved study overlap; it is not psychiatric treatment advice.

domainLinks.rationale: The clinical research record limits overbroad claims about biological approaches to psychiatric symptoms.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Separate endpoints, comparators, overlapping reviews and unresolved extraction.
Investigational clinical applications and risks are not a self-guided educational prescription.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The recorded guidance requires condition-, drug- and outcome-specific questions; no universal masking-versus-cure verdict or personal medication advice is supplied.

domainLinks.rationale: The record bounds claims about psychiatric medication rather than teaching a self-regulation strategy.

disciplineLinks.rationale: The site does not recommend starting, stopping or tapering medication.
Ask specific questions rather than impose a universal binary judgment.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: One observational self-report cohort supports the stated automaticity pattern. Selected model fits, modeled endpoints and limited access to full methods constrain generalization; no universal habit-change deadline follows.

domainLinks.rationale: The claim concerns automaticity in chosen daily behaviors repeated in a consistent context, not general identity transformation.
The record distinguishes observed repetition and modeled automaticity trajectories from a universal learning timescale.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Distinguish the modeled endpoint from the duration and measures actually observed.
Keep sample-selection and source-access limits attached to any frequently repeated numerical claim.
Self-reported automaticity is not a certificate of useful skill or changed-context performance.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The source records an association in a naturalistic student-transfer study. Self-report, attrition and nonrandom context changes limit causal and intervention conclusions.

domainLinks.rationale: The study concerns stability of established behaviors around a change of university context.
Context can matter to interpreting behavior, but this association does not prove a personal control strategy or superiority over intention.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Notice relevant circumstances and cues before attributing a behavioral change to intention alone.
Keep a naturalistic association separate from a randomized causal explanation.
Changed performance in a setting is distinct from evidence that a learned association has been erased.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: The construct distinction is supported within selected reports; no universal cause, independence claim or custom cure is established.

domainLinks.rationale: Direct distinction among connection-related constructs.
Needing connection is not diagnosed as failed self-command; no autonomy-for-relatedness substitution is established.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Distinguish felt loneliness from the circumstances of being alone.
Keep measured constructs and studied populations separate.
Consent and safety take priority over unwanted-contact obligations.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: One four-study report supports a scoped affect pattern; mixed outcomes and selected samples prevent a universal-solitude recommendation.

domainLinks.rationale: Directly concerns the experience of being alone.
The studies measured multiple affect dimensions during brief solitude.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Attend separately to arousal and pleasantness.
A group-level affect finding is not a validated personal treatment dose.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: Two selected trials and contextual synthesis support bounded intervention-specific findings, not individualized treatment advice or custom-method efficacy.

domainLinks.rationale: Specified interventions measured loneliness outcomes.
The studies do not validate self-guided substitutions or require unsafe social contact.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Compare exact programs, controls and endpoints.
Update findings when long-term, active-control and harm data become available.
Do not count a review and an included pilot as independent confirmations.

claimFacets.dispositionRationale: Small task-specific experiments and partially accessed synthesis support bounded contrasts, not a universal imagery percentage or mechanism equivalence.

domainLinks.rationale: Motor-task practice and performance outcomes are directly studied.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Separate task design, neural measures and behavior.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Specify the outcome and assessment delay.

Separate source overlap and prompted tasks from broader claims.

domainLinks.rationale: Directly studies strategy choices or immediate emotional outcomes.

disciplineLinks.rationale: Separate choice, feeling and neural measurement.

domainLinks.rationale: Manipulated expressive suppression.
